title: Chapter 51 — Trade Outreach: The Builder Cold Call & First Contact
intro: The research-first standard and the opening that earns thirty seconds, per buyer type.

sections.title: Research Before You Call
sections.content:
Never cold call a builder without knowing their work. Google them. Check their website. Look at their current projects. Understand their tier — are they building $300K starter homes or $2M custom homes? The opening is completely different.

For custom builders: 'Hi [name], I have seen your work on [project/neighbourhood] and the quality is impressive. I specialize in premium appliance packages for custom homes and I would love to show you how we support our builder partners.'

For volume builders: 'Hi [name], I know you are building [number] homes in [area]. We have a builder program with standardized packages, priority delivery scheduling, and dedicated support. Can I send you our spec sheets?'

sections.title: The First Contact Framework
sections.content:
Phone call for builders — they are on job sites and respond to calls. Email for designers — they work at desks and respond to visual presentations. LinkedIn for architects — professional context.

The goal of first contact is not to close. It is to earn a meeting. One meeting. That is all. 'Would you be open to a 15-minute meeting to see if we could help on your current projects?'
